name: Kijimadaira (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Kijimadaira village emblem in orange: a ring open at the bottom enclosing a stylised arrow pointing upwards.
history: Municipal flag of Kijimadaira, a village in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 14 July 1973.

features.role: Kijimadaira village emblem — a ring open at the bottom enclosing a stylised arrow pointing upwards
